code_style: AI-code. AI-generated attributed neutral semileptonic-kaon current inputs.
scope: Development reference for the finite neutral K0 to pion lepton neutrino virtual-photon current through chiral O(p4). A weighted four-body/dimuon rest-frame probe exists; it is not integrated into the unit-weight production runner. Absolute virtual-rate qualification, KL/KS source ownership, the charged-kaon projection and native transport remain separate qualifications.

explicit_conventions.l5_derivation: Invert the one-loop FK/Fpi expression: 1+5*mu_pi/4-mu_K/2-3*mu_eta/4+4*(MK^2-Mpi^2)*L5/Fpi^2, mu_P=MP^2*log(MP^2/mu^2)/(32*pi^2*Fpi^2). No decay rate was fitted.
explicit_conventions.subtraction: Primary lambda0=Delta_UV+1; L_i=L_i^r-Gamma_i*lambda0/(32*pi^2). Gamma5=3/8, Gamma9=1/4, Gamma10=-1/4.
explicit_conventions.normalization: The neutral K0 amplitude carries GF*Vus*epsilon_EM*e/sqrt(2). No dark-photon dimuon branching fraction or kaon source yield is included.
explicit_conventions.charge_sum: A KL/KS total over both charge-conjugate final states equals the single-flavour K0 partial width in the CP-symmetric DeltaS=DeltaQ limit. Do not add a second factor two.

derived_transcription_corrections: Eq22 requires 2*p_pi^mu contracted with the pair current, rather than the printed slash-pi between pair spinors.
The last K/eta B in Eq24 is B21. Its UV pole and independent on-shell f-minus comparison fix the tensor coefficient.

In Eq30 only the half-K dot Q B1 term uses the reversed mixed-mass routing: B1(K,pi)=B0(pi,K)-B1(pi,K). The printed common B1(pi,K) leaves the exact finite contact-Ward defect K dot Q*(B1(pi,K)-B0/2)*q^nu. Raw and corrected variants remain independently accessible.
remaining_qualifications: Resolve the absolute distinguishable K_mu3 e+e- TableII discrepancy; no factor-ten rate repair is authorized. The conversion factor independently matches the explicit pair-spin trace and two-body phase space, and two exact production proposals agree on the lower tree-level rate.
Converged integrated timelike rates and a qualified production proposal. The existing weighted rest-frame sampler preserves polarization, recoil and flight, but is not a unit-weight event generator.
Charged-kaon O(p4) projection and its distinct contact/loop terms.
Native kaon flight, material transport, recoil ownership and weighted full-source normalization.

real_photon_rate_control.scope: Historical real-photon validation only. These cuts and input changes are not production selections or fitted normalization factors. Timelike rates and native transport require separate qualification.

charged_leading_control.equations: 5.1 and 5.15, gauged initial-kaon pole and contact with massive-vector q terms retained
charged_leading_control.scope: Leading-current control only. Includes the amplitude Clebsch 1/sqrt(2), exact initial-kaon and final-lepton radiation and weak contact. The charged O(p4) timelike structure-dependent current is not implemented; the API rejects that order rather than using the neutral expression.

physics_limits: Historical chiral input benchmark; not a modern global fit of Kl3 form factors.
Chiral O(p6), isospin/electromagnetic corrections, and higher weak/electroweak matching are not supplied as a universal uncertainty bound.
Measured nonradiative f-plus/f-zero shapes do not determine the transverse timelike radiative current; no IB-only completeness claim is made.
